from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from .renderers import YAMLRenderer
from .models import CloudResourceUsage
from .serializers import ResourceUsageSerializer

class CloudResourceUsageReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, YAMLRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        if request.accepted_renderer.format == 'yaml':
            # DevOps automated YAML report query ignores user project filtering
            cluster_id = request.query_params.get('cluster_id')
            records = CloudResourceUsage.objects.filter(cluster_id=cluster_id) if cluster_id else CloudResourceUsage.objects.all()
        else:
            records = CloudResourceUsage.objects.filter(project__members=request.user)

        return Response(ResourceUsageSerializer(records, many=True).data)
diagnosis: CloudResourceUsageReportView behaves differently based on Content-Type negotiation. When YAML is requested, it filters CloudResourceUsage solely by cluster_id without verifying that request.user is a member of the project associated with that cluster. Any developer can inspect infrastructure resource consumption, costs, and virtual machine allocations of other clients' clusters by setting Accept: application/x-yaml.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from .renderers import YAMLRenderer
from .models import CloudResourceUsage
from .serializers import ResourceUsageSerializer

class CloudResourceUsageReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, YAMLRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        # Uniformly constrain query to projects where request.user is an authorized member
        records = CloudResourceUsage.objects.filter(project__members=request.user)
        cluster_id = request.query_params.get('cluster_id')
        if cluster_id:
            records = records.filter(cluster_id=cluster_id)

        return Response(ResourceUsageSerializer(records, many=True).data)
